description: Human-curated base configuration for supported-markets.json. The builder reads this file and overwrites generatedAtUtc at build time. All other fields are editorial policy decisions and must not be auto-promoted by the builder.

notes: Legacy/transitional EN PokemonTCG API pricing remains available for migration and diagnostics.
Normal app UI should not present this as a market estimate; app-visible pricing is eBay sold / Market Price Engine only.
AU/AUD eBay sold / Market Price Engine pricing is the intended user-facing pricing direction.
Market is planned but must not be shown to users until pricing is live.
JP market pricing is not available. No app-visible eBay sold / Market Price Engine route is live for JPY pricing.
EUR pricing via Cardmarket (tcgdex_cardmarket) is not yet built into the price cache pipeline.
Cardmarket is internal/reference only for app pricing; normal app UI should use eBay sold / Market Price Engine values only.
